Context: 1. House Building Advance

NOTE: Rate of interest is based on the prevailing rate at the time of payment of first instalment of Advance, i.e., March, 2023. No interest is payable for April, 2025, as there will be no balance outstanding on the last day of that month. The last instalment recoverable on 31-3-2025 and accountable on 1-4-2025 has been taken into account to arrive at the outstanding balance on 25-4-2025.
